Design study for gameplay · not a construction or life-safety plan

Direct drawing tools

Select (V): click a room or connection. Drag a room to move it, or any orange edge or corner to resize. Drag a door or passage along its shared wall. Middle-mouse drag pans in every mode without changing your tool.

Connect (C): drag from one room into another, or tap two rooms. A green shared-wall preview shows a valid connection. Choose single door, double door or open passage in the always-visible Connections panel. Double doors have two leaves and a total clear width. Open passages have no door leaf.

Disconnect (X): click a connection, or drag between two connected rooms. Draw room (P): drag a rectangle, snapped to 0.5 m with a 1 × 1 m minimum. Escape cancels a drag. Pan (H) protects the plan while you pan or pinch to zoom.

Delete / Backspace removes the selected room or connection. Room deletion confirms how many connections will also be removed. Undo restores the entire change. Typing in fields never triggers drawing shortcuts.

Linked stairs move and resize together on every level in their stack; local transfer stairs stay local. Legacy misalignment is preserved until you explicitly edit that stack. Courtyard and Operations voids follow their source room and cannot be moved separately. Freight shafts retain their existing locks. Actual overlapping room areas are shown in red; intentional void/shaft cutouts are excluded. The faint gray-brown layer is the floor below; switch it off with Below. Switching floors preserves your view. Stair treads in plan are symbolic. V8 and V9 are floor-plan revisions only; the V7 Blender model is unchanged. Corridors are editable rooms too. Plan checks flag overlaps, detached doors and rooms without a route to a floor entrance.

Undo / redo: Ctrl or ⌘ Z / Shift Z. Arrow keys move a selected room 0.5 m. SVG export produces editable vector linework for Figma; JSON preserves the complete editable model.

V9 preserves the 408 m² garage, 280 m² boarded B1 wing and 80 m² boarded L1 suite. The garage is 8 m clear with its floor 4 m below the clean B1 lobby. A full transfer stair follows wash and gowning, while a separate stair reaches B2 artifact intake/decon. B2 and B3 move down as complete levels so no research room overlaps the garage. L0 has a dedicated main-stair landing and a corridor-facing freight door. Cargo, clean staff and dirty returns use deliberate paths. Open the vertical stack for occupied height, service clearance, slab depth and all datums. All older layouts and their saved device edits remain separate. Blank plan space is exterior or unexcavated rock.
